简单
indexFields.characteristic: 通过弃牌使敌人变得脆弱。基本牌越多越好，没有牌时很脆弱。
indexFields.biography: 字文谦，魏“五子良将”之一。容貌短小，以胆烈跟从曹操，南征北讨，战功无数。从击袁绍于官渡，奋勇力战，斩袁绍部将淳于琼。又从击袁绍子谭、尚于黎阳，斩其大将严敬。从平荆州，留屯襄阳，进击关羽、苏非等人，击退其众，南郡诸郡的山谷蛮夷都前往乐进处投降。后来从曹操征孙权，假进节。曹操回师后，留乐进与张辽、李典屯于合肥。又以乐进数有军功，迁右将军。建安二十三年逝世，谥曰威侯。

skills.name: 骁果
skills.text: 其他角色的结束阶段，你可以弃置一张基本牌，令其选择一项：1.弃置一张装备牌，你摸一张牌；2.你对其造成1点伤害。
skills.mapping: optional turnEnding owner trigger with otherLiving turnOwnerScope; basic owner payment, actual turn owner choice, equipment payment or damage
notes: Both payments use existing cardCategories filters, including all basic card forms and all equipment subtypes without a hardcoded CardKind list.
The actual turn owner chooses the response and selects their equipment from hand or equipment zone. Without equipment, only the damage response is available.
Both discard movements await their child windows; a completed payment is not paid again on continuation.
Initial owner basic payment is the FirstNonTargetSelection availability prerequisite, so a hand without basic cards cannot offer the skill.

observations: The current OL hero/121 page requires a basic-card cost and is the sole source for implemented rules and presentation.
The 2024-01-31 anniversary announcement lists 乐进 as 魏, 4, 男, but its different any-hand-card cost is explicitly excluded. It is used only to corroborate the same character gender.
The official frontend treats initial_hp 0 as no override and renders all hp hearts filled. The page og:description 0体力 is an inconsistent metadata renderer.
孙茹 hero/632 currently uses 持室/慰勉; the earlier 影箭/释衅 candidate was excluded.
